title.narrative: General Emergency Funds support for communities affected by East Africa Food Crisis in Tonj North.

description.narrative: This approval is raised to provide WASH services to complement the Passionists project which is supporting the affected communities with food items. The project was designed in response to the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) report for South Sudan released on 09 April 2022 . According to the IPC report, an estimated 786,000 people (62.9% of the population) in Warrap state were reported to face food Crisis (IPC Phase 3) or worse acute food insecurity, whilst 385,000 people were in Emergency (IPC Phase 4) acute food insecurity. Except for Gogrial East which was classified in Crisis (IPC Phase 3) acute food insecurity, all other counties of Warrap state including Tonj North were classified in the Emergency (IPC Phase 4) acute food insecurity. Among the areas affected by successive episodes of inter communal violence and flooding include the greater Tonj area and in particular Tonj North. This is the largest county in South Sudan and has total of 165,222 people . Cropping, cattle rearing, and fishing are the most common means of livelihoods, all of which are greatly affected by these episodes.
